== Overview ==

. Vitox is a custom server based on Tibia 8.6, enhanced with content and some of features from newer versions (up to 13.2+). Built for players who love the old-school vibe with a modern twist!.. Visit our gallery to see what the server looks like!.. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
